full_judgment: 2. Facts of the case, briefly, are that the plaintiff appellants filed Title Suit No.147 of 1966, in the 6th Court of Munsif, Barisal for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in respect of 2.48 acres of land and the said suit was decreed on contest on 1.5.68 against the contesting defendant respondent No.1 (since dead and substituted by his heirs) and exparte against the rest. Defendant respondent No.1 filed Title Appeal No.131 of 1968 against the Judgment and decree of the learned Munsif and the appeal was allowed by the learned Additional District Judge, Barisal, by his judgment and decree dated 12.3.69. Appellants then preferred Second Appeal No. 1018 of 1969, in the then High Court of judicature at Dhaka in East Pakistan.
